title: callerya
intro: Callerya, commonly known as the Chinese foxglove or callerya plant, is a type of flowering plant native to China. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its potential health benefits, which include reducing fever, relieving cough and sore throat, and aiding in digestion. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to warm the body, dispel cold, and clear heat, which can help alleviate symptoms of respiratory and gastrointestinal issues. Bioactive constituents present in the plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
